description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ClientRepository component within the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM system. It contains test methods to verify behavior of client entity retrieval and validation logic, using fixtures for setup.

classes.name: ClientRepositoryTest
classes.description: A unit test class that tests the ClientRepository's methods for fetching and validating OAuth client entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test by loading fixture data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetClientEntity
methods.description: Verifies that specific client entities can be retrieved correctly and their properties match expected values.

methods.name: testValidateClient
methods.description: Comprehensively tests the client validation logic with various client IDs, secrets, and grant types to ensure correct validation behavior.
